stature.how: Barefoot against a wall, book flat on the crown, mark the wall, measure mark to floor.
stature.definition: Vertical distance from the crown (median line) to the floor, barefoot, heels and back against a wall.
stature.notes: σ 2.5 cm without the book (03 §2.3). Also the best whole-body photo scale bar (03 §3.1).

chest.how: Tape level under the arms and over the shoulder blades; read on a normal breath out.
chest.definition: Horizontal girth high under the arms and over the shoulder blades, normal breathing (EN 13402; = bust for children).
chest.notes: Breathing moves it about ±1 cm in small children (03 §2.3).

CPSC77:66-navel: navel waist ≈ natural waist + 1 cm at 2–6 y (03 §0.2.1)
ISO8559-1:5.3.10: ISO rib/iliac-midpoint level vs ribbon level: offset unknown (UNCERTAIN, 03 §1.1)

waist.how: Tie the ribbon first, let the child wiggle, then tape at the ribbon without pulling the tummy in.
waist.definition: Horizontal girth at the waist ribbon: narrow elastic tied on and settled by wiggling (Big-4/Ottobre natural waist).
waist.notes: Least reliable girth (belly, breath, meals; 03 §2.3). Target ±3 cm for an elastic/drawstring waist.

hip.how: Tape level round the fullest part of the seat; check it is level from the side.
hip.definition: Horizontal girth at the fullest part of the seat (greatest buttock projection seen from the side), over underwear.
hip.notes: Over underwear, not a nappy (see seat_over_nappy). ±2 cm is fine for full trousers (03 §6).

seat_over_nappy.how: Same as seat, over the usual nappy.
seat_over_nappy.definition: As hip, but taken over the nappy the garment will be worn over.
seat_over_nappy.notes: 06 Recommended defaults item 11. No free prior: the chart value is a placeholder (UNCERTAIN).

neck_base.how: Tape round the base of the neck where a T-shirt neckband sits: over the C7 bump and the breastbone notch.
neck_base.definition: Girth over C7, the front neck point (top of the breastbone notch) and both side neck points: the bodice neckline seam.
neck_base.notes: Ticklish; tape rides up to mid-neck (smaller).

CPSC77:36-biacromial: straight bony breadth → surface across back, +1 cm (UNCERTAIN)

across_back.how: Find the bony shoulder tips (mark them); tape across the back from tip to tip, arms hanging.
across_back.definition: Shoulder point (acromion tip) to shoulder point across the back, along the surface.
across_back.notes: Acromion is hard to find on a chubby, moving child (03 §2.3). Children need more back ease, not less.

shoulder_length.how: From where the neck meets the shoulder to the bony shoulder tip.
shoulder_length.definition: Side neck point to shoulder point along the top of the shoulder.
shoulder_length.notes: Only ~8 cm long, so 1 cm is >10% (03 §2.3, §6).

shoulder_slope_deg.how: Back photo P3, arms in A-pose; the agent clicks side-neck point and shoulder tip on both sides.
shoulder_slope_deg.definition: Angle below horizontal of the line from side neck point to shoulder point, from the P3 back photo (sheet upright).
shoulder_slope_deg.notes: 06 Q3 addition; tolerance ±3° (06 E3.2). No free prior: 18° ±5° is a placeholder (UNCERTAIN).

back_neck_to_waist.how: Head bent forward to find C7; tape straight down the spine to the ribbon's lower edge.
back_neck_to_waist.definition: From the C7 bump down the spine (along the surface) to the lower edge of the waist ribbon.

arm_length.how: Elbow slightly bent, hand on tummy; shoulder tip over the elbow to the wrist bone.
arm_length.definition: Shoulder point over a slightly bent elbow to the wrist bone (ulnar styloid).
arm_length.notes: Elbow bend and shrugging (03 §2.3); growth goes into the hem.

upper_arm.how: Arm hanging relaxed; tape round the thickest part halfway shoulder–elbow.
upper_arm.definition: Girth midway between shoulder point and elbow, perpendicular to the arm, arm relaxed.

wrist.how: Tape round the wrist over the knobbly bone.
wrist.definition: Girth at the wrist bone (ulnar styloid).
wrist.notes: Matters only for a fitted cuff; a closed cuff must pass the hand (hand_pass).

hand_pass.how: Thumb tucked to the palm; tape round the widest part of the hand (knuckles and thumb base).
hand_pass.definition: Smallest loop that slides over the hand with the thumb tucked into the palm: minimum opening of a cuff with no placket.
hand_pass.notes: No free prior in 03; chart value is a placeholder (UNCERTAIN).

SKILL:body-rise-standing: standing waist height − crotch height runs 1–2 cm shorter than seated (03 §1.1, §4.4; UNCERTAIN)

body_rise.how: Child sits upright on a hard chair; ruler/tape vertical at the side from ribbon to seat.
body_rise.definition: Seated on a hard flat chair: vertical distance from the side waist ribbon to the chair seat.
body_rise.notes: No exposed ISO clause (03 §1.1). Chair compression and slumping (03 §2.3).

total_crotch_length.how: Tape from the front ribbon, down and between the legs, up to the back ribbon; snug, child standing.
total_crotch_length.definition: From the centre-front waist ribbon down between the legs to the centre-back waist ribbon, along the body.
total_crotch_length.notes: 06 Q3 addition: decides trouser rise fit. Tape σ is a guess (UNCERTAIN). Over the nappy if worn.

inseam.how: Legs slightly apart; from the crotch straight down the inside leg to the floor.
inseam.definition: Crotch to floor, standing with legs slightly apart (toddler inside leg).

outseam.how: From the ribbon's lower edge at the side, over the hip, to the floor.
outseam.definition: From the lower edge of the waist ribbon down the side, over the hip, to the floor.
outseam.notes: The hem absorbs it; grows ~4.5 cm/yr (03 §2.4).

thigh.how: Tape level round the top of one leg, just under the seat crease.
thigh.definition: Maximum horizontal girth at the top of the leg just below the buttock crease.
thigh.notes: Fitted trousers only; a minimum for full trousers.

knee.how: Leg straight; tape round the middle of the kneecap.
knee.notes: Cuff level for knee-gathered trousers. No free prior in 03 (UNCERTAIN).

calf.how: Tape level round the fullest part of the calf.
calf.definition: Horizontal girth at the fullest part of the calf.

ankle.how: Tape round the narrowest part just above the ankle bones.
ankle.definition: Minimum girth just above the ankle bones.

foot_pass.how: Foot relaxed, toes pointed slightly; tape round the heel and over the top of the instep.
foot_pass.definition: Diagonal girth round the back of the heel and over the instep: the loop a closed cuff must pass over.
foot_pass.notes: Pass-over inequality for gathered cuffs (06 Q4). No free prior in 03 (UNCERTAIN).

head.how: Tape above the eyebrows and ears, over the bump at the back; measure at the intended band line.
head.definition: Maximum head girth above the brow ridges and over the back bump (occiput), 1–2 cm above the ears: the hat band line.
head.notes: Lowest-error tape item (03 §2.3). A fez has no stretch: ±0.5 cm ≈ half a hat size (03 §6).

belly_depth.how: Side photo P2 (profile, arms hanging); the agent clicks back surface and belly front on one horizontal line.
belly_depth.definition: Side view P2: horizontal front-to-back body depth at the most prominent point of the belly.
belly_depth.notes: 06 Q3 addition: drives front-hem lift. Prior derived from the section model (UNCERTAIN).

chest_depth.how: Side photo P2; back to front at chest level.
chest_depth.definition: Side view P2: horizontal front-to-back depth at chest level (under the arms).

waist_depth.how: Side photo P2; back to front at the ribbon.
waist_depth.definition: Side view P2: horizontal front-to-back depth at the waist ribbon.

hip_depth.how: Side photo P2; seat to front at hip level.
hip_depth.definition: Side view P2: horizontal depth at hip level (greatest buttock projection).

chest_width.how: Front photo P1; torso edge to torso edge just under the arms.
chest_width.definition: Front view P1: horizontal silhouette width of the torso at chest level, arms out (A-pose).

CPSC77:67-navel-breadth: navel-level breadth used for ribbon level (UNCERTAIN)

waist_width.how: Front photo P1; edge to edge along the ribbon.
waist_width.definition: Front view P1: silhouette width at the waist ribbon.

CPSC77:72-bitrochanteric: bony bitrochanteric breadth used as silhouette width (UNCERTAIN)

hip_width.how: Front photo P1; edge to edge at the fullest seat level.
hip_width.definition: Front view P1: silhouette width at hip level.

armscye_depth.how: Rarely measured: drafted from chest and stature (03 §1.2).
armscye_depth.definition: Vertical from the top of the shoulder at the shoulder point down to armpit (chest) level.
armscye_depth.notes: No free prior in 03; placeholder 0.13 × stature (UNCERTAIN).

waist_height.how: Ruler vertical at the side, ribbon to floor.
waist_height.definition: Vertical distance from the waist ribbon to the floor at the side.

crotch_height.how: Same as inseam but vertical; usually read from the front photo.
crotch_height.definition: Vertical distance from the crotch (highest point between the thighs) to the floor.

knee_height.how: Ruler vertical behind the knee to the floor.
knee_height.definition: Vertical distance from the back-of-knee crease to the floor.
knee_height.notes: No free prior in 03; placeholder 0.62 × crotch height (UNCERTAIN).
